data.gender_notes: Nawwaf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'nawwa' meaning 'to support, to be steadfast, and to remain constant'. The name Nawwaf signifies a person who is determined, steadfast, and constant in their beliefs and actions. The name Nawwaf carries the meaning “Determined, Steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawwaf usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
